newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed, fuel, gas oil slip.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed, fuel, gas oil slip.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline held steady in the face of falling crude and NYMEX futures, with prompt demand good, traders said.
A major Italian refiner said it planned to boost gasoline runs slightly to produce an additional 30,000-tonne cargo above contract requirements in November.
Prices for premium unleaded material were pegged around high fob quotes +$2, fob Italian islands.
Naphtha performed well against crude with healthy end-user buying interest seen for the second decade of November.
Prices were discussed at cif quotes high +$2/$4.
Gas oil slipped on a decline in underlying futures and several offers of Russian heating oil from Black Sea ports kept a lid on premiums.
A cargo of Russian was sold at cif quotes high +$1.50/1.75 cif Genoa for early November, at around unchanged levels. But physical trade overall was meagre.
The low sulphur market remains extremely quiet after several weeks in which material has regularly headed to northern Europe to chase the arbitrage to NWE.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil prices were soft in the Med and while offers were thin, demand was poor. November swaps were assessed at around $112 fob Med.

One trader said he saw another trader offering an M-40 out of sebastopol, and a high sulphur M-100 out of Novorossiisk. A Libyan Zawia cargo was also heard offered by a trader, and one refiner said the seller's price was $10 over the quoted high fob, fob Libya.
Two low sulphur cracked fuel oil cargo offers were heard at, or slightly below, $131 cif Italy.
